statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The service provided is CPT code 93247
CPT code 93247 represents long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias
